title: Unexpected keyword argument 'cls' forwarded to http.parse_cookie
detail: The original sansio.parse_cookie accepted a 'cls' kwarg to specify the dict type. After delegating to http.parse_cookie, which does not accept 'cls', any caller passing this kwarg will get a TypeError. This breaks backward compatibility and causes runtime failures.

title: Legacy 'cls' kwarg forwarded to http.parse_cookie in request.cookies
detail: The request.cookies property may pass a 'cls' kwarg to parse_cookie. Since http.parse_cookie does not accept this kwarg, a TypeError will be raised when a custom dict class is requested, breaking request handling.

title: parse_cookie returns empty dict when cookie is present
detail: The added line returns an empty ImmutableMultiDict as soon as a cookie string is detected, skipping the parsing logic that follows. The function should instead parse the cookie string into key/value pairs and return a populated ImmutableMultiDict.
note: Describes the planted negation: a cookie string that is given parses to nothing.

title: Inverted condition skips file data
detail: The code now continues when fp is not None, which means any non-None file-like object is ignored and its data is never read. This breaks file uploads and encoding.

title: Breakpoint setting condition inverted
detail: The code only sets breakpoints when both horizontal and vertical breakpoints are present, but it should set them when either set is present. This prevents breakpoints from being applied when only one type is defined.
